{{Top|leg}}
'''Villip beacons''' were a type of [[villip]] that could be placed in space to provide information to [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. [[Yomin Carr]] of the [[Praetorite Vong]] placed one of these at [[Vector Prime]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which gave instructions to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Koros-Strohna|worldship]], directing it to travel to [[Helska IV]].<ref name="Vector prime">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>

*''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'' {{Mo}}
